piece: P3 — Slash-Command Autocomplete in the Composer (gauntlet-sessions)

breadcrumbs.note: Critic round 1 FAIL claimed the piece was not built (said SlashAutocomplete.tsx does not exist, no getSlashCommands in IPC, ComposerInput untouched). That verdict was based on stale state: generator-state.json still described a prior P1 build and the critic evidently read a stale checkout. The P3 code was already present in the working tree. Re-verified the working tree, added the missing CSS, fixed one TS6133 (unused onDismiss -> renamed _onDismiss), and re-ran gates.

contract.ts: appended `| { method: "getSlashCommands"; params: {} }` to IpcCommand union (after testMcpServer, which another worker added) and SlashCommand interface at end of Data shapes. Append-only; no existing lines touched.

client.ts: added getSlashCommands to IpcClient interface, TauriIpcClient (send getSlashCommands), MockIpcClient (returns mockSlashCommands — 31 builtin commands derived from the prime-agent reference). Imported SlashCommand.

SlashAutocomplete.tsx (NEW): fuzzy subsequence match, rank exact-prefix > startsWith > subsequence > alphabetical, max 8 visible, selected highlight, click-to-select, mono command names + dim descriptions. Exports filterSlashCommands for reuse.

ComposerInput.tsx: useIpc() + useEffect fetch getSlashCommands on mount; updateSlashState opens dropdown when value starts with '/' and cursor on first line and no space after command; onKeyDown intercepts ArrowDown/ArrowUp/Enter/Escape ONLY while open; Enter inserts '/name ' and closes; renders SlashAutocomplete below textarea. Existing Enter/Alt+Enter/Escape/Alt+Up handling preserved.
chat.css: appended .slash-autocomplete (absolute above input, dark #151515, green ring, max-height 264px scroll) + item/name/desc/more styles.
npx tsc --noEmit -> 0 errors. npx vitest run -> 86/86 pass.

unverified: real daemon (Tauri) getSlashCommands path — verified against MockIpcClient; the Tauri client forwards the command to the sidecar which owns the real command discovery
